parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, constitutional equality, hate-crime law and a 2025 Equality Court order requiring inmate gender-affirming care indicate functioning state recourse and protection. Historic public acceptance and Pride infrastructure lower organised state targeting. But evidence shows serious trans-specific societal risk: recent severe tavern assault, current subregional statement that violence falls disproportionately on trans/gender-nonconforming people, older neglect/impunity, police mockery and document-mismatch fraud threats, contested bathroom access. Visitor-facing border, hotel and facility treatment are unresolved; absence of evidence is not safety, but open questions are weighted lightly. No universal unremedied exclusion is documented, so the result sits in Reduced Risk, below 0.85 anchors.
